note: Gunfright Enhanced colours: Jon Attree's painting of the original game's own figures, buildings, scenery and the twenty duel opponents (owner-approved 2026-11-07, published in Gunfright 1.1). No game data: each entry is a source address of the original graphics (decoded from the user's snapshot) and one palette digit per pixel, left to right; 0 keeps the original's own pixel (ink or paper), any other digit is an index into palette. A run covers consecutive source bytes, 8 digits each (town and bandit: consecutive mask/ink pairs, two bytes apart); bandit is the street bandits' own map, duel the opponents' shared map and opponents[n] each opponent's own differences from it.
